build_source_profiles: build source profiles for TORAX plasma simulation with explicit or implicit mode
build_standard_source_profiles: build standard source profiles by updating calculated source profiles with computed values
build_all_zero_profiles: build all zero source profiles for a given torus geometry
get_all_source_profiles: get all implicit and explicit source profiles for initializing a simulation time step
update_standard_source_profiles: update standard source profiles in a SourceProfiles object by source name and affected core profile type
